name: AerialExtreMatch-Benchmark
description:
AerialExtreMatch — Benchmark Dataset
	

Code | Project Page | Paper
This repo contains the benchmark set for our paper AerialExtreMatch: A Benchmark for Extreme-View Image Matching and Localization. 32 difficulty levels are included. We also provide train and localization datasets.

	
	
	
		Usage
	

Simply clone this repository and unzip the dataset files.
git clone git@hf.co:datasets/Xecades/AerialExtreMatch-Benchmark
cd AerialExtreMatch-Benchmark
unzip "*.zip"
rm -rf *.zip
rm -rf… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Xecades/AerialExtreMatch-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: localization_accuracy / pose_error (e.g., recall@N, pose error thresholds)
general_score_metric: localization_accuracy (percentage of queries localized within an error threshold, often reported as recall@N)
reputation: A specialized benchmark for extreme-view aerial image matching and localization with moderate recognition in the remote-sensing and visual-localization research communities.
